headline: Higher pensions for thousands of people blocked. No approval from the Ministry of Finance
summary: About 196,000 seniors await higher pensions after a Constitutional Tribunal ruling, but the Finance Ministry has not approved funding for the reforms.
why: Pension spending is a major component of public finances, and funding decisions affect government deficits and fiscal policy.
original_headline: Wyższe emerytury dla tysięcy osób zablokowane. Nie ma zgody MF
